content: उत्क्षेप {%a.%} Throwing up, tossing. .{@-पः@} .²1 Throwing or tossing up; पक्ष्मोत्क्षेप <ls>Me. 49</ls>. .²2 That which is thrown or tossed up; बिन्दूत्क्षेपान् पिपासुः <ls>M. 2. 13</ls>. .²3 Sending, despatching. .²4 Throwing away, rejecting. .²5 Vomiting. .²6 The region above the temples (dual).
